page.overview:
What is Kaladesh block?

Kaladesh block belongs to Magic: The Gathering. The Kaladesh block is composed of the large expansion Kaladesh () and the small expansion Aether Revolt ().

It was released in 2016-2017. The Masterpiece Series set for this block is Kaladesh Inventions (). Although appearing in the booster packs the Masterpiece Series is not considered to be part of the block.
